# `silk/simd/i16x16`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Operations on `simd<i16, 16>`: sixteen signed 16-bit integer lanes in one 256-bit vector.

## When to use
Use this module to work on sixteen `i16` values at once. Use [`load`](#load) and [`store`](#store)
to move lanes between a slice and a vector, a lane comparison such as [`lanesEqual`](#lanesEqual) to make
a `mask<16>`, and `silk.simd.mask16` to test that mask.

## Details
The operators `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `%`, `&`, `|`, `^` and `~` apply lane by lane and trap
exactly where the `i16` operator traps. Use [`wrappingAdd`](#wrappingAdd) or [`saturatingAdd`](#saturatingAdd) when
overflow is expected. `==` is true only when every lane is equal.
Lane `0` is at the lowest address in memory.

## Examples
### Find the first matching lane
```silk
import silk.simd.mask16
import silk.simd.i16x16

pub fn main() -> i32 {
  let mut values: [i16; 16] = i16x16.toArray(i16x16.splat(0))
  values[15] = -3
  let hits = i16x16.lanesEqual(i16x16.fromArray(values), i16x16.splat(-3))
  if !mask16.any(hits) || mask16.firstSet(hits) != 15 {
    return 1
  }
  return 0
}
```

Import as `i16x16` with `import silk.simd.i16x16 as i16x16`.

<a id="load"></a>

## `load`

```silk
pub fn load(lanes: &[i16], offset: usize) -> simd<i16, 16>
```

Reads [`LANES`](#LANES) lanes of `lanes` starting at `offset`.

### Gotchas
Traps unless `offset + LANES` is at most `lanes.length`. The slice needs no alignment beyond
`i16`.

<a id="store"></a>

## `store`

```silk
pub fn store(lanes: &mut [i16], offset: usize, vector: simd<i16, 16>) -> ()
```

Writes the lanes of `vector` into `lanes` starting at `offset`.

### Gotchas
Traps unless `offset + LANES` is at most `lanes.length`.

<a id="loadUnchecked"></a>

## `loadUnchecked`

```silk
pub unsafe fn loadUnchecked(pointer: [*]const i16) -> simd<i16, 16>
```

Reads [`LANES`](#LANES) lanes starting at `pointer`, with no bounds check.

### Gotchas
The caller proves that `pointer` addresses [`LANES`](#LANES) live lanes aligned to `i16`.

<a id="shuffle"></a>

## `shuffle`

```silk
pub fn shuffle(left: simd<i16, 16>, right: simd<i16, 16>, static indices: [usize; 16]) -> simd<i16, 16>
```

Returns a vector whose lane `i` is lane `indices[i]` of `left` followed by `right`.

### Details
An index below [`LANES`](#LANES) selects from `left`, and an index from [`LANES`](#LANES) to `2 * LANES - 1`
selects from `right`. The indices are static, so each call is one fixed lane permutation.
